Checklist
The following documents have to be submitted together with this application form,
a) if you obtained your Master’s degree at a German institution of higher education
in the field of Physics:
• Master’s certificate (certified copy – Certification possible in the dean’s office)
• Copy of ID or passport (certified copy – Certification possible in the dean’s office)
• Form Confirmation of Supervision of PhD Student
• Curriculum vitae (signed)
• A written statement as to whether you are aware of any criminal investigation against
you
b) if the degree entitling the holder to doctoral studies was obtained in another subject
and/or at a university outside Germany, the following must also be submitted:
• Certified copy of the Bachelor’s certificate as well as the final transcript of records of
both Bachelor’s and Master’s
c) if admission to doctoral studies is sought with an excellent Bachelor's degree, further
information is required. See the form Supplement to the Application for Admission to
Doctoral Studies, without a Master's Degree but with an Excellent Bachelor's Degree.
